hook: Porukam turns a verbal agreement into a legally meaningful contract and walks the deal step by step, all the way to settlement.
problem: Agreeing in words is easy. Proving later what was agreed, when the work was delivered and what to pay for is hard. Porukam keeps that record for both sides.
contractText: Pick the deal type: services, sale, rent or a loan. Answer plain-language questions and get a ready document. No legal wording to write.
stagesText: Split the deal into stages, each with a list of what must be done. The contractor marks items done and attaches photos; the customer accepts or returns the stage with remarks. Both sides always see where the deal stands and whose move is next.
paymentText: Payment follows the stages: accepted means paid. We do not hold your money and charge no fee for signing. Settlements stay between you; the platform records what was accepted and paid, and when.
evidenceText: Photos, files and messages are attached to the stage and sealed with a trusted timestamp. A signed contract never changes except through an amendment both parties see and confirm. If a dispute comes, you have what it takes to close it.
reputationText: A reputation card is assembled from completed deals, not from reviews anyone can write about anyone.
